title: API Lifecycle Management
summary: This module provides decorators and utilities for managing the lifecycle of API components, including emitting warnings for beta features and deprecated functionalities. It helps maintain API stability and informs users about changes.

nodes.label: Wrap Sync Beta Function
nodes.title: Synchronous Beta Feature Wrapper
nodes.description: Decorates synchronous functions to issue a one-time warning when a beta feature is called directly by external code.

nodes.label: Wrap Async Beta Function
nodes.title: Asynchronous Beta Feature Wrapper
nodes.description: Decorates asynchronous functions to issue a one-time warning when a beta feature is called directly by external code.

nodes.label: Check Beta Class Instance
nodes.title: Beta Class Direct Instantiation Check
nodes.description: Checks if a beta class is being directly instantiated by external code and issues a warning if so.

nodes.label: Beta Property Getter
nodes.title: Beta Property Access (Get)
nodes.description: Handles property 'get' operations for beta features, emitting a warning if accessed on an instance.

nodes.label: Beta Property Setter
nodes.title: Beta Property Access (Set)
nodes.description: Handles property 'set' operations for beta features, emitting a warning if modified on an instance.

nodes.label: Beta Property Deleter
nodes.title: Beta Property Access (Delete)
nodes.description: Handles property 'delete' operations for beta features, emitting a warning if deleted from an instance.

nodes.label: Wrap Sync Deprecated Function
nodes.title: Synchronous Deprecated Feature Wrapper
nodes.description: Decorates synchronous functions to issue a one-time warning when a deprecated feature is called directly by external code.

nodes.label: Wrap Async Deprecated Function
nodes.title: Asynchronous Deprecated Feature Wrapper
nodes.description: Decorates asynchronous functions to issue a one-time warning when a deprecated feature is called directly by external code.

nodes.label: Check Deprecated Class Instance
nodes.title: Deprecated Class Direct Instantiation Check
nodes.description: Checks if a deprecated class is being directly instantiated by external code and issues a warning if so.

nodes.label: Is Internal Caller?
nodes.title: Determine Caller Origin
nodes.description: Utility function to determine if the current code execution originates from within the library or from an external user.

nodes.label: Issue Warning
nodes.title: Emit API Warning Message
nodes.description: Function responsible for generating and displaying a warning message to the user, indicating beta status or deprecation.

nodes.label: Execute Original Logic
nodes.title: Run Wrapped Function/Method
nodes.description: Represents the execution of the original function, method, or property operation after checks and warnings have been handled.

groups.label: Beta API Management
groups.title: Manage Beta API Features
groups.description: Provides decorators and utilities to manage the lifecycle of API components marked as beta, ensuring users are warned upon direct usage while allowing internal development without constant warnings. This includes handling functions, async functions, class instantiations, and property access.

groups.label: Deprecation API Management
groups.title: Manage Deprecated API Components
groups.description: Offers decorators and utilities to manage the deprecation of API components, providing warnings to users when deprecated functions, async functions, or classes are directly accessed, facilitating smooth transitions to newer alternatives.
